metadata.epic6_canonical_trial_method: Three sequential isolated PostgreSQL fixtures with 100 active visible datasets. metadata.epic6_direct_projection_trial_method: Three sequential direct-projection trials with five excluded warmups and 120 measured serial invocations. Concurrent direct-projection workloads use per-wave barriers at 1, 10, and 25 workers.

epic6_materiality_gate.representative_workload_requirement: At least one 100-record rewritten result and one canonical authorized result must exceed the proposed materiality threshold without security or behavior regressions.
epic6_materiality_gate.reproducibility_requirement: Three independent trials with five warmups and 120 measured serial iterations, plus bounded 1/10/25-worker concurrency evidence.
epic6_materiality_gate.security_requirement: Projection parity, canonical admission, namespace isolation, visibility, persona freshness, capability revocation, and error-contract regressions must pass.

metadata.epic6_parse_serialization_attribution: Direct projection timing measures the unmodified production function as one unit. JSON decoding, rewrite checks, and encoding are not exclusively attributed because RR-09.1 does not modify production interfaces or instrument implementation internals.
metadata.epic6_sql_attribution: Whole-operation SQL uses a benchmark-local Django execute_wrapper. Inclusive Registry stage timings are reported separately and are never subtracted or summed.
metadata.methodology: RR-09.1 measures the unmodified production grouped-result projection function with deterministic direct fixtures. Guarded PostgreSQL canonical list evidence replaces only its explicit placeholders; unsupported canonical scenarios remain not_measured with their exact fixture limitation.
